import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    static int[] memo = new int[10000000];

    static int solve(long n) {
        if (n == 0) return 0;
        if (n < memo.length && memo[(int)n] != 0) return memo[(int)n];

        long best = 1000000000000000000L; // 1e18
        long rep = 1;
        int steps = 0;
        // generate repunits until distance starts increasing
        for (long x = 1; ; x = x * 10 + 1, steps++) {
            long diff = Math.abs(x - n);
            if (diff > best) break;
            best = diff;
            rep = x;
        }
        // rep is the last repunit that gave non-increasing diff
        if (rep > n && rep / 10 != 0) {
            long prev = rep / 10;
            int res = Math.min(steps + solve(Math.abs(rep - n)), steps - 1 + solve(Math.abs(prev - n)));
            if (n < memo.length) memo[(int)n] = res;
            return res;
        }
        int res = steps + solve(Math.abs(rep - n));
        if (n < memo.length) memo[(int)n] = res;
        return res;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = sc.nextLong();
        System.out.println(solve(n));
        sc.close();
    }
}
